summary: A download endpoint joins a user-supplied name onto an upload root without confirming the result stays inside it.

defects.summary: The query parameter is joined onto UPLOAD_ROOT with no containment check, so ../ escapes the upload directory
The unsanitised name is interpolated into a Content-Disposition header value

distractors.summary: existsSync in a request path is a minor style choice here, not a behavioural defect worth blocking on.
